reasons.plausibility: The mechanism of brittle intermetallic precipitate formation at higher annealing temperatures reducing toughness is well aligned with established metallurgical principles for high-entropy alloys.
reasons.testability: Microstructural and mechanical tests on specimens annealed under carefully controlled temperatures offers a clear and decisive method to confirm or refute the proposed mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis provides a straightforward approach to optimizing thermal processing to preserve toughness, offering practical guidance to researchers in the field of high-entropy alloys.
